method: Two serial repeats per configuration. Same Sukumo application, server/viewer/compositor binaries and packaged renderer; source selects cached masks or full fonts. Private TCP byte/propagation proxy, no loss/real WAN congestion emulation. Startup is process/window/network/native-renderer readiness, polled at 50 ms; bytes are all retained data sent by readiness, not exactly the first packet. Steady capture-visible scene age begins after four seconds warmup. No concurrent builds or integration tests.
